title: The ratelimit-operator schema.
description: JSON Schema for the ratelimit-operator chart. The root stays open: the platform passes one parameter set to every chart of the application, so the service chart's blocks reach this schema and are ignored. The blocks this chart reads are closed.

NAMESPACE.title: The NAMESPACE schema
NAMESPACE.description: The namespace it is going to be deployed.

MANAGED_BY.title: The MANAGED_BY schema
MANAGED_BY.description: The tool being used to manage the operation of an application

ARTIFACT_DESCRIPTOR_VERSION.title: The ARTIFACT_DESCRIPTOR_VERSION schema
ARTIFACT_DESCRIPTOR_VERSION.description: Artifact descriptor version which is installed

DEPLOYMENT_SESSION_ID.title: The DEPLOYMENT_SESSION_ID schema
DEPLOYMENT_SESSION_ID.description: Unique identifier of deployment session used to track e2e deploy activity

READONLY_CONTAINER_FILE_SYSTEM_ENABLED.title: The READONLY_CONTAINER_FILE_SYSTEM_ENABLED schema
READONLY_CONTAINER_FILE_SYSTEM_ENABLED.description: Read-only container file system is enabled

DEPLOYMENT_STRATEGY_TYPE.title: The DEPLOYMENT_STRATEGY_TYPE schema
DEPLOYMENT_STRATEGY_TYPE.description: Specify Deployment Strategy type for deploying service

filter.title: Gateway filter

timeout.title: Check timeout
timeout.description: Envoy-side timeout for a rate limit check, as a protobuf duration: seconds with an optional fraction, e.g. 0.05s. Go-style values such as 50ms are rejected by Envoy.

failClosed.title: Fail closed
failClosed.description: true rejects traffic with a 503 when the rate limit service is unreachable, times out, or answers UNAVAILABLE because its counter store failed (failure_mode_deny); false lets it flow unlimited.

rateLimitedStatus.title: Refusal status
rateLimitedStatus.description: Status the client sees on a refused request. Envoy ignores values below 400.

grpcAsResourceExhausted.title: gRPC refusal code
grpcAsResourceExhausted.description: true maps a refusal to RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED for gRPC callers behind the gateway — the code their clients back off and retry on — instead of UNAVAILABLE.

xRateLimitHeaders.title: x-ratelimit response headers
xRateLimitHeaders.description: The service supplies the x-ratelimit-* and retry-after headers itself. DRAFT_VERSION_03 additionally lets Envoy render X-RateLimit-* from per-descriptor statuses, which the service does not populate, so OFF is the default.

filter.description: The install-wide defaults of the rate limit filter on each gateway; gateways.<role> overrides them per gateway. The port the filters send checks to is the contract's 9000 and is not a value.

runtime.title: Filter switches
runtime.description: Share of requests the filter checks (enabledPercent) and enforces on (enforcedPercent). Emergency controls independent of behavior: Shadow in the rules; rendered as Envoy runtime fractions, so a runtime override flips them without a redeploy.

MONITORING_ENABLED.title: The MONITORING_ENABLED schema
MONITORING_ENABLED.description: Set to true to import dashboards to Grafana and configure integration with Prometheus. Requires Platform System Monitor CRDs to be deployed to target k8s/openshift cluster

alerts.title: Alert rules
alerts.description: The PrometheusRule of the chart, rendered with MONITORING_ENABLED; the thresholds and hold durations the expressions read.

enabled.description: Render the PrometheusRule over the policy status. Read only with MONITORING_ENABLED.

stalledFor.description: How long a domain stays Stalled before RatelimitStalled fires.

notReadyFor.description: How long a policy stays not Ready before RatelimitNotReadyLong fires.

ruleProblemsFor.description: How long a blocking problem stays on the latest generation before RatelimitRuleProblems fires.

noReplicasFor.description: How long a domain has no ready service replica before RatelimitNoReplicas fires.

checksStoppedWindow.description: The window over which a domain enforced by ready replicas receiving no check fires RatelimitChecksStopped.

checksStoppedFor.description: How long a domain receives no check before RatelimitChecksStopped fires.

configWriteErrorsWindow.description: The window over which any ConfigMap write error fires RatelimitConfigWriteErrors.

noLeaderFor.description: How long no operator pod holds the Lease before RatelimitNoOperatorLeader fires.

ISTIO_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_NAME.title: The ISTIO_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_NAME schema
ISTIO_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_NAME.description: Name of the public Istio gateway.

ISTIO_PRIVATE_GATEWAY_NAME.title: The ISTIO_PRIVATE_GATEWAY_NAME schema
ISTIO_PRIVATE_GATEWAY_NAME.description: Name of the private Istio gateway.

gateways.title: Rate limited gateways
gateways.description: One EnvoyFilter is rendered per enabled gateway. The gateway names come from the ISTIO_*_GATEWAY_NAME parameters, not from here.

enabled.description: Render an EnvoyFilter for this gateway.

domain.title: Rate limit domain
domain.description: Binding key between this gateway and a RateLimitPolicy. Must equal spec.domain of the policy that carries the gateway's rules; a mismatch is silent apart from an unknown-rate-limit-domain line in the service log. The pattern is the CRD's spec.domain pattern, so a value the policy side cannot ever carry is refused here too.

namespace.title: Gateway namespace
namespace.description: Namespace of the Gateway. The EnvoyFilter is created there, because Istio resolves targetRefs within the EnvoyFilter's own namespace. Defaults to the release namespace, which is where qubership-core-mesh-config puts the gateways; set it only if they live elsewhere.

timeout.title: Check timeout override
timeout.description: Overrides filter.timeout for this gateway. Same format: a protobuf duration such as 0.05s.

failClosed.title: Fail closed override
failClosed.description: Overrides filter.failClosed for this gateway. An explicit false wins over a true default.

rateLimitedStatus.title: Refusal status override
rateLimitedStatus.description: Overrides filter.rateLimitedStatus for this gateway. Envoy ignores values below 400.

enabled.description: Render an EnvoyFilter for this gateway.

domain.title: Rate limit domain
domain.description: Binding key between this gateway and a RateLimitPolicy. Must equal spec.domain of the policy that carries the gateway's rules; a mismatch is silent apart from an unknown-rate-limit-domain line in the service log. The pattern is the CRD's spec.domain pattern, so a value the policy side cannot ever carry is refused here too.

namespace.title: Gateway namespace
namespace.description: Namespace of the Gateway. The EnvoyFilter is created there, because Istio resolves targetRefs within the EnvoyFilter's own namespace. Defaults to the release namespace, which is where qubership-core-mesh-config puts the gateways; set it only if they live elsewhere.

timeout.title: Check timeout override
timeout.description: Overrides filter.timeout for this gateway. Same format: a protobuf duration such as 0.05s.

failClosed.title: Fail closed override
failClosed.description: Overrides filter.failClosed for this gateway. An explicit false wins over a true default.

rateLimitedStatus.title: Refusal status override
rateLimitedStatus.description: Overrides filter.rateLimitedStatus for this gateway. Envoy ignores values below 400.

name.description: Defaults to the chart's fullname when empty.

CLOUD_TOPOLOGIES.title: Topologies settings for topologySpreadConstraints
CLOUD_TOPOLOGIES.description: Array of topologies settings for topologySpreadConstraints. Each array item must contain at least 'topologyKey' attribute. Other supported attributes are 'maxSkew' and 'whenUnsatisfiable' - optional.

MEMORY_REQUEST.title: The MEMORY_REQUEST schema
MEMORY_REQUEST.description: Defines minimum amount of memory the container will use to start
